verdict.rationale: Automated retry of failed subscription payments with dunning and recovery emails is a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no subscription billing, dunning schedules or recovery emails. Idempotent retries cover safely re-sending a disrupted API call, not recovering declined recurring charges. The AI acceptance-rate optimization is a different feature, and subscription support via plugins belongs to the host platforms, not Checkout.com.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can automatically retry failed subscription payments with smart dunning and recovery emails
